annotations.title: Get a link to connect an account

description: Return the real Soclo connect link for the named platform (the owner opens it in a browser, signs in, and returns to Soclo). Needs only read:accounts and is free. X Ads: pass accountId, the owned X posting account from soclo_accounts_list. Snapchat: this returns the real link for connecting a Snapchat public profile; after approving in Snapchat, if the flow asks which public profile to connect, finish that choice in the Soclo app. Sharing a Snap as a person still runs through the app’s Snapchat share, which hands off to Snapchat’s own editor for the owner to confirm, never a silent API post. There is no Snapchat ads product in Soclo, so there is no "snapchat ads" connection to make or report. If this reports no_aggregator_profile, run soclo_accounts_bootstrap before requesting a connect link.

accountId.description: The connected account id, from soclo_accounts_list. For X Ads connect: the owned X posting account id.

platform.description: The platform to connect, e.g. instagram, facebook, tiktok, linkedin, pinterest, youtube, threads, bluesky, telegram, reddit, whatsapp or snapchat.

name: soclo_accounts_connect
